name: helturkey/php-webtrawler
description: A PHP-first web scraping and crawling toolkit with adaptive extraction, concurrent spiders, and optional browser automation.

suggest.playwright-php/playwright: Optional Chromium automation for JavaScript rendering, browser sessions, and request/response capture. Requires Node.js 20+ and installed Playwright browsers.
suggest.dekor/php-impity: Optional PSR-18 transport using curl-impersonate for browser-like TLS and HTTP/2 fingerprints. Requires the matching curl-impersonate binary.
suggest.ext-intl: Required to fetch internationalized (non-ASCII) host names such as https://example.com/.
suggest.ext-mbstring: Faster, broader charset conversion for non-UTF-8 pages (iconv is used as a fallback).
suggest.illuminate/support: Laravel 13 integration: service provider, Scrape facade, configuration and scraper:fetch command (Testbench 11.x in development tests).
suggest.ext-pcntl: Lets `scraper crawl` stop cleanly on Ctrl-C / SIGTERM and save its resume state.
suggest.ext-posix: Enables ownership checks on browser-session directories.

scripts-descriptions.check: Run code style, static analysis and tests.
